legacy_accumulation_audit.normalization: remove include lines, CUDA __device__ and MSL device qualifiers, normalize whitespace
legacy_accumulation_audit.accumulation: Pinned CPU routines on shared Metal buffers; legacy kernels are not executed

final_state.post_timing_change: Metal initial admission 16 -> 20 GiB; CPU remains 16; worker unchanged; refusal/recovery passed

refusal.error: host RAM is short for risc0:generic: needs ~20.0 GiB, 93.0 GiB already reserved by proofs in flight, 44.7 GiB available

post_campaign_admission.scope: After timing, raised initial Metal admission budget from 16 to 20 GiB based on the observed 17.3-GiB startup group peak. CPU budget stays 16 GiB. Proving worker binary unchanged.

replan.reason: Code review found autoreleased Metal command buffers/encoders without an explicit per-dispatch pool; bound their lifetimes before final acceptance.
replan.policy: Retain all verified warmups, completed measured pairs, started requests, logs and future pending slots; repeat a new complete campaign on the corrected binary.

retained_pilot.scope: pre-pool-correction correctness observations, excluded from final comparison

limitations: Five warm measured pairs on Fibonacci(150000) at po2 20; one excluded first-process warmup per mode.
10M arithmetic and hashing are single first-process proofs, not new five-sample usefulness medians.
Witness generation, accumulation, RV32IM segments, identity-p254 and Groth16 use CPU.
Process footprints and thermal state are sampled; no energy or marketplace competitiveness claim.
The step-4 CPU 46M proof was not repeated with Metal.
